commentaire: The following riders tested positive for EPO after today's stage and are therefore disqualified from stage 7 and all further stages of the Vuelta a Guatemala: Yeisson DELGADO (actual leader after stage 7 and 4th in today's stage), Lizandro Roberto AJCU (winner of stage 7 and 3th in the general classification), Federico MUNOZ FERNANDEZ (8th in today's stage and 10th in the general classification).
titre: Vuelta a Guatemala, Stage 7 : Retalhuleu - Quetzaltenango (105 km)
